issues_confirmed: No build or packaging script exists anywhere in the repo (git ls-files shows no .sh/.py/.bat/.ps1), .gitignore:11 excludes *.mcaddon, and no release is cut - so TESTING_IPAD.md:13's instruction to 'download scythe_addon.mcaddon directly' from the repo is impossible. This was proposed as task 2 on 2026-10-06 and skipped while tasks 1 and 3 were implemented.

resource_pack/attachables/scythe.json:11 maps the 3D model's default texture to textures/items/iron_scythe (the 16x16 item icon), and resource_pack/models/entity/scythe.geo.json:22-40 box-UVs its cubes onto mostly-transparent regions of it. Measured by decoding the PNG and counting alpha: the blade cube (size [2,8,2], uv [0,0]) samples u0-8 v0-10, of which 9/80 pixels are opaque (11%); the handle cube (size [1,8,1], uv [8,0]) samples u8-12 v0-9 at 18/36 opaque but lands on the blade's steel pixels, not the brown handle. With entity_alphatest (attachables/scythe.json:7) the held scythe renders as a near-invisible sliver with the wrong colours.

resource_pack/textures/items/iron_scythe.png has a 2-pixel break between the handle and the blade. Alpha down column 8 for rows 0-9 decodes as [255,255,255,0,0,255,255,255,255,255] - rows 3 and 4 are empty, so the blade (rows 0-2, cols 8-10) floats above the rivet (row 5, cols 7-8) and handle (rows 6-15, cols 6-8).

resource_pack/items/scythe.json:2,6 declares format_version '1.21.0' but uses description.category: 'Equipment', the field replaced by menu_category in the modern schema; the file also duplicates the identifier and icon that behavior_pack/items/scythe.json:17-19 now owns, making it redundant.
behavior_pack/loot_tables/items/scythe.json is referenced by no other file in either pack - confirmed by grepping all JSON for 'loot_table', which matches only last_run.json's own prior note.

behavior_pack/items/scythe.json:38-40 sets minecraft:display_name.value to the literal string 'Iron Scythe' rather than the key item.scythe:iron_scythe.name that resource_pack/texts/en_US.lang:1 defines, so the lang file is never read.
TESTING_IPAD.md:97 and :102 both describe the scythe texture as a grey silhouette / grey shape, which has been false since commit 2560df4 drew real 8-colour pixel art.
README.md:59 still lists '- [ ] Add iron_scythe.png texture (16x16)' as open; it was done in 2560df4.

behavior_pack/pack_icon.png and resource_pack/pack_icon.png are byte-identical (md5 60a910e7077915701565e6275fd27e9c) and decode to a flat three-colour dark-blue blob, so the two packs are indistinguishable in the in-game pack list.

resource_pack/animations/scythe.animation.json:4-12 is a single static pose (rotation [0,0,-45], position [4,-4,0], loop: true) with no keyframes and no first-person/third-person split, so the hold pose will be wrong in one of the two views.

verdict: Two fixes away from genuinely finished. The item definition is now correct and the icon is real pixel art, but with no packaging script it has still never been loaded in-game, and the 3D attachable will render near-invisible because it UV-maps onto the item icon. Ship build.sh, delete the attachable chain, and this is done - the scope is one weapon and that weapon is basically built. Resist adding Script API features before a first successful load.
